question: When an AI claims a major scientific breakthrough, who should check it, and how long should we wait before believing it?
reflection: Careful checking is not the enemy of progress; it is what turns a bold claim into knowledge people can build on.

sources.subject: Can China's AI Boom Pay Off?
Google Genie 4, Anthropic Claude Drug Discovery, IBM RAG 65x Less

one_line: Frontier labs now claim their models have produced proofs that could overturn long-held assumptions in maths and computing, and experts are only starting to check them.

top_stories.title: AI labs claim proofs that challenge a core computing assumption
top_stories.what: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models independently found algorithms that challenge a 30-year-old assumption about how hard certain problems are, and OpenAI also claims proofs on other famous open problems; independent experts are still reviewing them.
top_stories.why: If confirmed, AI becomes a source of original research, which changes how universities and funders judge, credit and verify scientific work.

top_stories.title: Claude moves into real drug labs
top_stories.what: Anthropic shared early results from six biotech partnerships, including tens of thousands of antibody designs for food allergies and help with clinical-trial planning, all still before any patient testing.
top_stories.why: AI support for trial planning could change how health research is designed, which creates demand for careful evaluation of where it helps and where it misleads.

top_stories.title: Bank asks customers not to give AI assistants their passwords
top_stories.what: Bank of America urged customers to stop sharing banking logins with AI assistants, as more people let agents act on their behalf.
top_stories.why: How people decide what to hand over to an AI helper is a live behavioural question, and banks and regulators need clear, tested guidance messages.

saudi_lens.text: Saudi banks and the central bank could test simple, plain-Arabic messages that warn customers about sharing logins with AI assistants, as agent use spreads.
Saudi research funders may soon need rules on how AI-generated proofs and findings are reviewed and credited.

idea.title: Safe delegation nudges
idea.pitch: A randomised trial of short in-app messages that help bank customers decide what information is safe to give an AI assistant.
idea.fit: Financial regulator, banks, government digital services
idea.first_step: Draft three message versions (rule, story, social norm) and test comprehension with 20 people.
